description: This source file contains unit tests for the Orleans code generator, checking various scenarios of source code that uses Orleans serialization, grain interfaces, dynamic proxies, and attributes. It includes tests for serializer generation, proxy creation, attribute handling, and diagnostics, utilizing Roslyn source generators and snapshot testing.
